xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5187: File explorer C: Monaco code pane, autosave, conflict handling, write services

plan.title: File explorer C: Monaco code pane, autosave, conflict handling, write services
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no way to edit an arbitrary file of a project checkout or workspace from the dashboard. The file explorer epic (PAN-5183) needs a code pane with Monaco, safe autosave that never silently overwrites changes another process made on disk, and server services that write, create, rename, copy, delete and restore files inside an explorer root.
narratives.Proposal: Server: write.ts (writeFile with the disk-signature precondition table and atomic temp-file rename, create, rename/move with an EXDEV-safe moveEntry, copy) and trash.ts (delete to <OVERDECK_HOME>/trash with a manifest, validated restore, 7-day prune), replacing PAN-5185's handler stubs. Client: a lazily loaded CodePane rendering Monaco (all languages in the lazy chunk only), an in-memory drafts store, a per-file save queue, a 1,000 ms autosave controller, a self-write registry, an external-change controller fed by PAN-5186's watch hub, an external-change banner with Compare/Reload/Keep/Overwrite, a Changes view against HEAD, preview tabs through PAN-5186's openCodePane, markdown preview and word wrap. Stage and tree items wait for PAN-5186 to merge; server and pure modules do not.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No explorer tree, git colors, quick open or content search (PAN-5186 owns them); this issue only changes the tree's file-row click to open preview panes.
- No re-creation of PAN-5186 modules (the 'code' pane type and fields, openCodePane, the watch hub) on this branch.
- No viewers for images, PDF, audio, fonts, large text, archives, SQLite or Office (PAN-5188, PAN-5189); non-text files show NonTextFallback.
- No file-action UI: inline create/rename rows, drag move, duplicate naming, delete confirmation, undo/redo, OS drop, drag to composer (PAN-5190).
- No edit workspaces and no editing of project roots; project-root files open read-only (PAN-5191 changes that).
- No download or upload HTTP routes (PAN-5188).
- No new StageApi or StageDeckContext members.
- No window-level keyboard listeners and no Monaco addCommand bindings.
- No atomic compare-and-swap against other processes beyond the documented precondition race.
- No minimap, rich markdown editor or language servers.
- No persistence of drafts, the save queue or external-change state; the trash is the only new on-disk data.

autoDecisions.summary: Code panes build on PAN-5186's 'code' pane type, openCodePane and watch hub instead of re-creating them; the four Stage/tree items task_block until PAN-5186 merges.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5186's plan (D-B2 to D-B5) built these seams for this issue; duplicating them on two parallel branches would conflict in panesStore.ts, PaneBar.tsx and Stage/index.tsx. Server and pure items still run first, so little time is lost. A comment on the issue asks for PAN-5186 to be added as an order-book prereq (the Flywheel tell failed: not running).

autoDecisions.summary: Project-root files open read-only with a one-line note until PAN-5191 adds edit workspaces.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every project-root write is refused with EDIT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED by PAN-5185; an editable pane whose saves always fail would lose work or confuse the operator.

autoDecisions.summary: The trash payload lives under <entry>/files/ next to .overdeck-trash.json, with compact ISO stamps.
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent's layout collides when the deleted path is itself named .overdeck-trash.json; a subfolder removes the collision and keeps names readable and parseable for prune.

autoDecisions.summary: Writes follow a symlink that resolves inside the root and replace its target atomically.
autoDecisions.rationale: This matches every editor and keeps the link; escapes are already refused by PAN-5185's resolveInsideRoot.

autoDecisions.summary: Monaco language comes from the client path via monaco.languages.getLanguages(), not the server's lang field.
autoDecisions.rationale: The server's languageForPath returns Shiki ids (bash, tsx, mdx, toml) that Monaco does not recognize.

autoDecisions.summary: The all-languages editor.main.js import lives only in the lazy MonacoCodeEditor chunk; the shared monaco-setup.ts imports editor.api.js and the workers.
autoDecisions.rationale: ContextEditor shares the setup and must not pull every language into its chunk.

autoDecisions.summary: A new INVALID_TARGET error code is added for moving or copying a folder into itself.
autoDecisions.rationale: None of the parent's codes describe this case, and reusing PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT or ALREADY_EXISTS would mislead the UI.

autoDecisions.summary: Parent AC-11's tree Ctrl+Z check is verified at the RPC level here and through the tree in PAN-5190.
autoDecisions.rationale: Undo is PAN-5190's UI; this issue ships only the services.

autoDecisions.summary: Closing a code pane with an armed autosave timer saves at once.
autoDecisions.rationale: Typing and closing within one second should not leave the change only in memory; the draft also survives either way.

metadata.sizeJustification: The parent PRD already split the explorer epic into seven children, and this child's three work items (client save path, conflict handling, server write services) form one protocol: the signature precondition, the save queue and the external-change logic only make sense together, and PAN-5190 and PAN-5191 already depend on this grouping in the order book. The surface is 51 concrete files, about 20 of them new test files, under three directories (services/explorer/, components/explorer/code/, docs) plus single-line touches to existing files. The plan is decomposed into 20 small items with serial edges only where files are shared.

items.title: Server writeFile with the disk-signature precondition and atomic write (PRD WI-11.1)

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Server-only; shares no file with any frontend item.

narrative.Action: Merge origin/main and confirm the PAN-5185 names in PRD §2 exist (D-C1). Create src/dashboard/server/services/explorer/write.ts exporting writeFile(root, rel, text, expectedSignature, allowMissing) exactly per PRD WI-11.1: FILE_TOO_LARGE over 5 MiB (D-C5), resolveInsideRoot forWrite, the D-C4 precondition table, symlink-follow with dangling links refused as NOT_FOUND (D-C3), atomic temp-file write with fsync and mode preservation, return { signature, mtimeMs }. Replace the PAN-5185 handler stub for WS_METHODS.explorerWriteFile in ws-rpc-explorer.ts with an Effect.tryPromise handler, and set the pan.explorerWriteFile no-loss row door (D-C2). Write write.test.ts with every case PRD WI-11.1 lists, using a temp git repo.

items.title: Given a file whose signature matches expectedSignature, when writeFile runs, then it saves the new text and returns the signature of the new bytes; with a mismatching signature it throws DISK_CONFLICT and the file bytes stay unchanged

Given a missing file, writeFile with a signature and allowMissing false throws DISK_CONFLICT, with allowMissing true it creates the file and any missing parent folder, and with expectedSignature null it creates the file

A file with mode 0o755 preserves mode 0o755 after writeFile, a symlink to a file inside the root remains a symlink whose target contains the new text, a dangling symlink throws NOT_FOUND and creates nothing, and no .overdeck-tmp- file remains in the folder
writeFile rejects a project root with EDIT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED, a .git/config path with PATH_IN_GIT_DIR, and text one byte over 5 MiB with FILE_TOO_LARGE
The pan.explorerWriteFile row in no-loss-matrix.ts contains the door string naming services/explorer/write.ts and PAN-5187, and no-loss-matrix.test.ts passes

expected_outputs: write.test.ts passes including the create cases

narrative.Action: In write.ts add statEntry(root, rel) returning an ExplorerEntry with ignored false (D-C11) and create(root, rel, kind) per PRD WI-11.2: resolve for write, mkdir the parent recursively, create the file with flag wx or mkdir the folder, map EEXIST to ALREADY_EXISTS. Replace the explorerCreate handler stub in ws-rpc-explorer.ts and set its no-loss row door. Add the create cases to write.test.ts.

items.title: When create runs with kind file or dir on a free path, then it creates the entry on disk and returns an entry whose kind and path match the request
Given an existing file or folder at the path, create throws ALREADY_EXISTS and the existing entry is preserved unchanged
Given a path whose parent folder is missing, create creates the parent folders and the entry
Server rename/move with the EXDEV-safe moveEntry helper (PRD WI-11.3)

expected_outputs: write.test.ts passes including the rename and moveEntry cases
typecheck and typecheck:contracts complete without errors

narrative.Action: In write.ts add moveEntry(from, to, ops) with the rename-then-EXDEV-copy-and-remove fallback (D-C9) and rename(root, from, to) per PRD WI-11.3: NOT_FOUND for a missing source, INVALID_TARGET for a move into itself (D-C10), ALREADY_EXISTS for an occupied target unless lstat dev and ino match (case-only rename), NOT_FOUND for a missing target parent. Add INVALID_TARGET to EXPLORER_ERROR_CODES in packages/contracts/src/explorer.ts. Replace the explorerRename stub and set its no-loss row door. Add the rename cases to write.test.ts.

items.title: When rename moves a file, or a folder with contents into another folder, then the source path no longer exists and the target contains the same bytes
rename throws ALREADY_EXISTS for an occupied target and INVALID_TARGET for a folder moved into its own subfolder, and EXPLORER_ERROR_CODES contains INVALID_TARGET
Given injected ops.rename that throws an EXDEV error, when moveEntry runs, then it copies the entry to the target and deletes the source
A case-only rename of a.txt to A.txt resolves without throwing and A.txt exists afterwards
Server copy for files and folders (PRD WI-11.4)

expected_outputs: write.test.ts passes including the copy cases

narrative.Action: In write.ts add copy(root, from, to) per PRD WI-11.4: resolve both for write, NOT_FOUND for a missing source, INVALID_TARGET for a copy into itself, ALREADY_EXISTS when lstat of the target succeeds, then fs.cp with recursive, errorOnExist, force false and verbatimSymlinks, returning statEntry. Replace the explorerCopy stub and set its no-loss row door. Add the copy cases to write.test.ts.

items.title: When copy runs on a file, then the target contains bytes identical to the source and the source is preserved
When copy runs on a folder, then every nested file exists under the target with identical bytes
copy throws ALREADY_EXISTS for an occupied target and INVALID_TARGET for a copy into its own subfolder
Server delete to the Overdeck trash, restore and prune (PRD WI-11.5)

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Server-only; ordered after s-copy only because both edit ws-rpc-explorer.ts and the no-loss matrix.

narrative.Action: Checkpoint first: if PAN-5185 already created a trash module for discarding untracked files, extend it instead of adding a second one. Otherwise create src/dashboard/server/services/explorer/trash.ts with rootSlug, formatStamp, parseStamp, trashPaths, restore and pruneTrash exactly per PRD WI-11.5 and decisions D-C6 (layout with files/ subfolder and .overdeck-trash.json manifest under getOverdeckHome()/trash), D-C7 (restore validates the trash id shape, root slug, manifest rootId and re-resolves the manifest path for write) and D-C8 (validate all paths before moving any, drop nested paths, prune errors logged and swallowed). Use moveEntry from write.ts. Replace the explorerDelete and explorerRestore stubs and set their no-loss row doors. Write trash.test.ts with OVERDECK_HOME pointed at a temp dir and an injected clock.

items.title: Given a file and a folder with contents, when trashPaths then restore run with the returned ids, then both return to the same paths with identical bytes and the trash entry directory is deleted

restore throws ALREADY_EXISTS for an occupied path, NOT_FOUND for a trash id of another root slug, a malformed id or an id containing .., and PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT for a manifest edited to point at ../outside
Given one missing path among several, trashPaths throws NOT_FOUND and moves nothing; given a and a/b in one call, it returns exactly one trash id
Given an injected clock, pruneTrash deletes entries older than 7 days, preserves newer entries and preserves directories whose names parseStamp rejects
trashPaths rejects a project root with EDIT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED, restore rejects it too, and every test stores trash entries only under the temp OVERDECK_HOME
explorerReadFile with ref HEAD returns the committed text (PRD WI-11.6)

expected_outputs: read.test.ts passes including both ref HEAD cases

narrative.Action: Checkpoint: read PAN-5185's read.ts for a ref branch. If it exists and read.test.ts covers both cases below, add no code and close the item with an empty commit (git commit --allow-empty) carrying the Item: s-read-head trailer, push, then pan task done; if only one case is covered, add the missing test case. Otherwise implement PRD WI-11.6 in read.ts: resolve the path for read, run git show HEAD:<rel> with async execFile, a 10 s timeout, a 6 MiB buffer and -c core.fsmonitor=false, return the decoded text with writable false, and return empty text for a file not in HEAD or a non-git root.

items.title: Given a committed file modified in the working tree, explorerReadFile with ref HEAD returns the committed text and writable false
Given a new untracked file, explorerReadFile with ref HEAD returns empty text without throwing

In-memory drafts store keyed by root and path (PRD WI-8.3)

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run --configLoader runner src/components/explorer/code/__tests__/code-drafts.test.ts

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/explorer/code/code-drafts.ts: a non-persisted zustand 4 store of CodeDraft { text, baseText, baseSignature } keyed by draftKey(rootId, path), with the actions loaded, edited, saved, reset, keepMine, rekey and drop and the selector selectIsDirty, with exactly the semantics in PRD WI-8.3 (loaded keeps a dirty draft's text; saved leaves the draft dirty when the text changed since the save started). It must not import from components/Stage. Add code/__tests__/code-drafts.test.ts.

items.title: Given a dirty draft, when loaded runs with a different signature, then the draft text and base are preserved unchanged
When saved runs with text that differs from the current draft text, then the base updates to the saved text and selectIsDirty returns true; with equal text selectIsDirty returns false
keepMine preserves the draft text and sets the base to the disk text and signature, and rekey moves a draft to a new key
A draft survives when no component subscribes to the store: after the subscribing test component unmounts, the store still returns the dirty draft
Per-file save queue ported from Orca (PRD WI-8.4)

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run --configLoader runner src/components/explorer/code/__tests__/save-queue.test.ts

narrative.Action: Run git -C ~/Projects/orca log --oneline c6b9ac9549b..origin/main -- src/renderer/src/components/editor/save/queue/editor-save-queue.ts and port from the newest commit. Create code/save-queue.ts with the Orca port header and createSaveQueue(deps) per PRD WI-8.4: one write in flight per key, the newest queued request replaces older ones, expectedSignature read from getBaseSignature at dispatch time, overwrite sends null, an error drops the queued request and calls onError, plus isInFlight and whenIdle. Add code/__tests__/save-queue.test.ts with fake timers and a deferred fake write.

items.title: Given a write in flight, when three more requests are enqueued for the same key, then exactly one more write is sent after the first resolves and it carries the last text
The second write sends the signature the first write returned as expectedSignature, and a request with overwrite true sends expectedSignature null
When a write throws, then the queued request for that key is dropped and onError receives the error
Writes for two different keys run in parallel, and whenIdle resolves only after the key has nothing in flight or queued

Add code/__tests__/self-write-registry.test.ts.

items.title: isRecentSelfWrite returns true for the recorded signature within 750 ms and returns false for another signature
